_comment: Duplicate venue identities in the city event data. Two source pages can describe the same physical venue under slightly different text, which produced two venue rows for one place: one carrying verified AMap coordinates and one carrying the events. Collapsing them is a venue-IDENTITY decision (same name, same city, same address text), not a fact rewrite. Each alias keeps the evidence that justifies it.

_format.alias_id: the duplicate venue row id that events currently reference
_format.canonical_id: the row that becomes the source of truth
_format.name: the shared venue name both rows represent
_format.reason: why these are the same place
_format.evidence_url: a source that fixes the identity

aliases.name: 苏州国际博览中心
